projects.title: RescueGrid-AI
projects.summary: Real-time emergency management platform powered by AI services.
projects.description: A tactical emergency response platform featuring a React & TypeScript frontend, a core Node.js & Express & TypeScript backend with MongoDB data storage and Socket.IO real-time communication, and a Python FastAPI AI microservice for intelligent incident processing and summaries.
keyFeatures: Real-time tactical response dashboard utilizing Socket.IO web sockets
Core Node.js, Express & TypeScript backend handling API routing and MongoDB data models
Python FastAPI AI microservice for generating automated incident summaries and processing AI workloads

Interactive digital learning modules and progress tracking
RESTful API architecture with robust error handling and middleware security
